## Course Overview

This workshop is designed for beginners who want to use R for public health data analysis.

## Topics Covered

- Introduction to R and RStudio
- Data import and cleaning
- Descriptive statistics
- Data visualization
- Regression analysis
- Report generation using Quarto

## Target Audience

Students, researchers, public health professionals, and health economists.

## Duration

3 days / 5 days

## Mode

Hands-on workshop
